title: Head of Plant Production Engineering
text:
Your Contribution
=================

The Head of Plant Production Engineering is responsible for leading all Production Engineering activities associated with customer projects, product acquisitions, new product launches, industrialization, and production readiness within the plant. This position serves as the plant's primary owner for Production Engineering processes, ensuring successful execution of the Product Development Process (PDP) from acquisition through Start of Production (SOP) and ramp-up. The role provides leadership to Production Engineers, drives standardization and deployment of manufacturing concepts, ensures manufacturability of product designs, manages capital investments, and represents Operations within project core teams. The Plant Head of Production Engineering ensures project launches meet safety, quality, delivery, cost, and operational performance objectives.

* Lead, develop, coach, & manage the plant Production Engineering organization.
* Build organizational capability to support current and future product launches.
* Own industrialization activities for all customer projects within the plant. Ensure successful execution of product launches from acquisition and business transfer through SOP and stabilization.
* Lead development of manufacturing concepts, production processes, line layouts, and assembly strategies.
* Ensure product designs are manufacturable and meet operational standards.
* Coordinate launch readiness across Manufacturing Engineering, Tooling Engineering, Quality, Logistics, Purchasing, and Operations Support acquisition reviews and participate in PAC, PRC, and pre-development activities.
* Ensure implementation of Design-for-Manufacturing principles throughout project development. Ensure compliance with MAHLE PDP milestones, gates, deliverables, and timing requirements. Oversee completion of all Production Engineering deliverables throughout all quality gates.
* Monitor project status, risks, cost performance, capacity requirements, and launch readiness. Lead escalation activities when project risks threaten timing, quality, or cost objectives. Review project dashboards and launch metrics with plant leadership and program teams.
* Approve and govern: Manufacturing concepts, Process flows, Plant layouts, Assembly concepts, Material flow strategies, Value stream integration.
* Ensure application of Lean Manufacturing and Manufacturing Optimization Process (MOP) methodologies in alignment with Operations Excellence Manager.
* Drive takt-time analysis, line balancing, ergonomic studies, and capacity planning. Validate cycle times using MTM or equivalent engineering methods. Ensure implementation of standardized manufacturing processes across the region.
* Ensure development, completion, and approval of Process FMEA (P-FMEA), Control Plans, Special Characteristics, Process Capability Studies, Validation Plans. Support flawless launch activities and manufacturing risk reduction. Lead readiness reviews for installation checks, internal process approval, internal run at rate, customer run at rate, PPAP readiness. Ensure production systems consistently achieve quality and operational KPI’s.
* Lead capital expenditure planning and approval activities. Validate business cases and investment requirements. Ensure optimal utilization of existing equipment before requesting new capital. Support supplier selection through PDC and SDC processes. Approve manufacturing equipment specifications. Participate in procurement and acceptance of production equipment, tooling, fixtures, and test systems.
* Chair Production Engineering project meetings, and lead the plant Production Engineering Extended Team, ensuring effective communication between Project Core Teams and Plant Extended Teams.

Your Experience & Qualifications

* Bachelor’s Degree required, B.S. in Engineering, or related technical discipline required. Master’s Degree preferred.
* 8+ years’ experience in manufacturing, launch, industrialization, or production engineering.
* 5+ years’ progressive leadership responsibility regarding engineering or manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated success in leading complex product launches and PDP projects.
* Experience in an automotive manufacturing facility required; high volume, medium to large campus experience preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge in IATF16949, ISO14001 and 45001 Audits and processes.
* Excellent diagnostic abilities / root cause analysis required; Lean Six Sigma and Black Belt certification strongly preferred.

Our Offer

We will provide a collaborative environment working on exciting assignments, along with ongoing personal & career development opportunities. We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single requirement. You may just be the right candidate for this or other roles! After receiving your online application, the interview process will typically be, a screening call followed by Personal Interview(s).

 

#DiversityMatters with our inclusive culture, we welcome applications from all social, religious & ethnical backgrounds, disabilities both mental and physical, identities (gender) and neurodivergent people.

 

MAHLE is not currently hiring individuals for this position who now or in the future require sponsorship for employment based non-immigrant and immigrant visas. However, as a global company, MAHLE offers many job opportunities outside of the U.S. which can be found through our employment website www.jobs.mahle.com
